data.subject: Local Ledger for KMT
data.body:
Hi,

KMT Wealth Management’s most recent 13F, for the period ended June 30, 2026, shows positions in NVA, OPAD, and AHT.

NVA filed a notice of late 10-K filing (NT 10-K) on September 29, 2026 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1852551/000149315226044708/0001493152-26-044708-index.htm).

I publish a free weekly issue based solely on public records and can offer a four-week fund pilot.

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
